voice: Kokoro v1.0 af_heart (kokoro-onnx, open weights), speed 0.96

f1.text: Forty-three instruments, laid out three ways. These are design layouts, not built labs.
f1.spoken: Forty-three instruments, laid out three ways. These are design layouts, not built labs.
f1.phonemes: fˈɔːɹɾiθɹˈiː ˈɪnstɹəmənts, lˈeɪd ˈaʊt θɹˈiː wˈeɪz. ðiːz ɑːɹ dɪzˈaɪn lˈeɪaʊts, nˌɑːt bˈɪlt lˈæbz.

f2.text: First, a conventional materials lab, grouped by workflow: rooms for powder, the metal printers, the machine shop, the furnace and the SEM, and open benches for the rest.
f2.spoken: First, a conventional materials lab, grouped by workflow: rooms for powder, the metal printers, the machine shop, the furnace and the SEM, and open benches for the rest.
f2.phonemes: fˈɜːst, ɐ kənvˈɛnʃənəl mətˈɪɹiəlz lˈæb, ɡɹˈuːpt baɪ wˈɜːkfloʊ: ɹˈuːmz fɔːɹ pˈaʊdɚ, ðə mˈɛɾəl pɹˈɪntɚz, ðə məʃˈiːn ʃˈɑːp, ðə fˈɜːnɪs ænd ðɪ ˈɛs ˈiː ˈɛm, ænd ˈoʊpən bˈɛntʃᵻz fɚðə ɹˈɛst.

f3.text: Benches are thirty inches deep and aisles five feet wide, with service space behind every floor machine. Measured to its walls, it comes to 4,280 square feet.
f3.spoken: Benches are thirty inches deep and aisles five feet wide, with service space behind every floor machine. Measured to its walls, it comes to four thousand two hundred eighty square feet.
f3.phonemes: bˈɛntʃᵻz ɑːɹ θˈɜːɾi ˈɪntʃᵻz dˈiːp ænd ˈaɪəlz fˈaɪv fˈiːt wˈaɪd, wɪð sˈɜːvɪs spˈeɪs bᵻhˌaɪnd ˈɛvɹi flˈɔːɹ məʃˈiːn. mˈɛʒɚd tʊ ɪts wˈɔːlz, ɪt kˈʌmz tə fˈɔːɹ θˈaʊzənd tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd ˈeɪɾi skwˈɛɹ fˈiːt.

f4.text: Next, the same floor plan, automated. Mobile robots drive the routes people walked, with fixed arms, docking targets and sample racks at the stations.
f4.spoken: Next, the same floor plan, automated. Mobile robots drive the routes people walked, with fixed arms, docking targets and sample racks at the stations.
f4.phonemes: nˈɛkst, ðə sˈeɪm flˈɔːɹ plˈæn, ˈɔːɾəmˌeɪɾᵻd. mˈoʊbəl ɹˈoʊbɑːts dɹˈaɪv ðə ɹˈaʊts pˈiːpəl wˈɔːkt, wɪð fˈɪkst ˈɑːɹmz, dˈɑːkɪŋ tˈɑːɹɡɪts ænd sˈæmpəl ɹˈæks æt ðə stˈeɪʃənz.

f5.text: The floor area stays the same. And a robot docked in a five-foot aisle leaves too little room for another to pass.
f5.spoken: The floor area stays the same. And a robot docked in a five-foot aisle leaves too little room for another to pass.
f5.phonemes: ðə flˈɔːɹ ˈɛɹiə stˈeɪz ðə sˈeɪm. ænd ɐ ɹˈoʊbɑːt dˈɑːkt ɪn ɐ fˈaɪvfˈʊt ˈaɪəl lˈiːvz tˈuː lˈɪɾəl ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðɚ tə pˈæs.

f6.text: The vertical lab. Two Kardex Shuttles come in, and every benchtop instrument moves onto a tray.
f6.spoken: The vertical lab. Two Kardex Shuttles come in, and every benchtop instrument moves onto a tray.
f6.phonemes: ðə vˈɜːɾɪkəl lˈæb. tˈuː kˈɑːɹdɛks ʃˈʌɾəlz kˈʌm ˈɪn, ænd ˈɛvɹi bˈɛntʃtɑːp ˈɪnstɹəmənt mˈuːvz ˌɑːntʊ ɐ tɹˈeɪ.

f7.text: The floor machines rearrange along one robot aisle, and the floor area falls to 3,029 square feet.
f7.spoken: The floor machines rearrange along one robot aisle, and the floor area falls to three thousand twenty-nine square feet.
f7.phonemes: ðə flˈɔːɹ məʃˈiːnz ɹˌiːɚɹˈeɪndʒ ɐlˈɔŋ wˈʌn ɹˈoʊbɑːt ˈaɪəl, ænd ðə flˈɔːɹ ˈɛɹiə fˈɔːlz tə θɹˈiː θˈaʊzənd twˈɛntinˈaɪn skwˈɛɹ fˈiːt.

f8.text: Side by side, the vertical lab needs 29 percent less floor: 14.2 instruments per thousand square feet, against 10.0.
f8.spoken: Side by side, the vertical lab needs 29 percent less floor: fourteen point two instruments per thousand square feet, against ten point oh.
f8.phonemes: sˈaɪd baɪ sˈaɪd, ðə vˈɜːɾɪkəl lˈæb nˈiːdz twˈɛnti nˈaɪn pɚsˈɛnt lˈɛs flˈɔːɹ: fˈɔːɹtiːn pˈɔɪnt tˈuː ˈɪnstɹəmənts pɜː θˈaʊzənd skwˈɛɹ fˈiːt, ɐɡˈɛnst tˈɛn pˈɔɪnt ˈoʊ.

f9.text: Most of what is left is floor machines, their clearances and the robot aisle. And the Shuttles stand 9.15 meters tall, so it needs a high bay.
f9.spoken: Most of what is left is floor machines, their clearances and the robot aisle. And the Shuttles stand nine point one five meters tall, so it needs a high bay.
f9.phonemes: mˈoʊst əv wʌt ɪz lˈɛft ɪz flˈɔːɹ məʃˈiːnz, ðɛɹ klˈɪɹənsᵻz ænd ðə ɹˈoʊbɑːt ˈaɪəl. ænd ðə ʃˈʌɾəlz stˈænd nˈaɪn pˈɔɪnt wˈʌn fˈaɪv mˈiːɾɚz tˈɔːl, sˌoʊ ɪt nˈiːdz ɐ hˈaɪ bˈeɪ.

f10.text: For scale, Emerald Cloud Lab in South San Francisco held more than a hundred items of equipment in about 15,000 square feet.
f10.spoken: For scale, Emerald Cloud Lab in South San Francisco held more than a hundred items of equipment in about fifteen thousand square feet.
f10.phonemes: fɔːɹ skˈeɪl, ˈɛmɚɹəld klˈaʊd lˈæb ɪn sˈaʊθ sˌæn fɹænsˈɪskoʊ hˈɛld mˈɔːɹ ðˌænə hˈʌndɹɪd ˈaɪɾəmz ʌv ɪkwˈɪpmənt ɪn ɐbˌaʊt fˈɪftiːn θˈaʊzənd skwˈɛɹ fˈiːt.
